reason: A proposes a single, compositionally defined bulk intervention with a clear baseline, composition series, quantitative retention criterion, and decisive falsification test; Co substitution can plausibly modify both microstructure and magnetostructural behavior, although its claimed grain-boundary mechanism remains speculative. B is less compelling because it leaves coating chemistry ambiguous, a ~50 nm film is unlikely to improve bulk tensile strength substantially, and its cited evidence concerns coated micro/nanolattices rather than MnNiSi magnetocaloric materials.
